heading: Short title
lead: This subchapter may be cited as the “Civil Liberties Act of 1988”.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 1989b of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Short Title of 1992 Amendment
notes.text: Pub. L. 102–371, § 1, Sept. 27, 1992, 106 Stat. 1167, provided that: “This Act [see Tables for classification] may be cited as the ‘Civil Liberties Act Amendments of 1992’.”
